_comment: CR-074 (2026-07-21): baseline reset to errors: [] (empty). The pre-CR-074 74-entry baseline was stale (line numbers and names no longer matched current code — e.g. baseline pinned noise_suppressor.py:192 col 9 'Object of class `object` has no attribute `channels`' but actual line 192 is a `log.debug(...)` call with no `.channels` access; baseline pinned config_validators.py:886 'Name `_check_hotkey_type` is listed in `__all__` but is not defined' but grep for the 9 bad-dunder-all baseline names returned 0 matches in current code). Pyrefly 1.1.1 was installed in the sandbox and `pyrefly check voice_typer/` reported 16 errors (32 suppressed, 84 warnings) — see _note_fluctuation. We deliberately set errors: [] as the conservative ratchet floor (per CR-074 'safe direction since the audit will catch growth from 0'). The audit step in .github/workflows/build.yml was also fixed by CR-010 to read the `errors` key (was `suppressed` — mismatched with pyrefly output, audit always saw 0).
_justification: See worklog Fix-O section for the original categorization of the pre-CR-074 74 entries. After CR-074 reset, the baseline is empty — every previously-suppressed platform-specific false positive is now either fixed inline (via local stubs in voice_typer/stubs/ or `# pyrefly: ignore` annotations) or expected to surface as a fresh audit-detectable error if it recurs. The audit step (`Audit pyrefly baseline changes` in build.yml) catches any growth above 0.
_note_fluctuation: Error count fluctuates as Fix-agent file modifications land. As of 2026-07-21 regeneration with pyrefly 1.1.1, the actual error count is 16 (with 32 suppressed) — but the baseline is intentionally set to errors: [] (the conservative floor) per CR-074. Any PR that introduces a new pyrefly error will fail the audit; existing errors should be fixed one-by-one (the audit's `Added entries` diff lists exactly which path:line:code pairs are new).
_regeneration_note: PVT-G5-020 (2026-07-21): pyrefly is NOT installed in the current sandbox, so this baseline was NOT regenerated from a fresh `pyrefly check` run as part of the FA11-retry fix. The `errors: []` floor (set by CR-074) is preserved unchanged. When pyrefly becomes available (locally or in CI), regenerate this file with the exact command: `pyrefly check voice_typer/ --output-format=json > pyrefly-baseline.json`. The regeneration will overwrite this file with the current live error list; commit the result and confirm the audit step (`Audit pyrefly baseline changes` in .github/workflows/build.yml) reports zero 'Added entries'. Do NOT hand-edit the `errors` array — it must come directly from pyrefly's JSON output so the audit's path:line:code diffing is meaningful.
